name: Control Animal
verbal: [Animal type] of the [terrain type] heed my call
description: Stacking evocation: costs 1 EP per resistance level of a natural animal (up to the caster’s level). EP reductions apply to the total cost. Can be cast open-ended, paying after resolution.

name: Create Water
verbal: Purest Water come unto me.
description: Creates a pint of pure, fresh drinking water seen to appear from the caster’s fingertips.

name: Predict Weather
verbal: Air and water reveal to me thy course
description: Reasonably predicts the next 24 hours of weather for the area; may hint if manipulated (ref’s discretion).

name: Barkskin
verbal: Oak and Elm I beseech thee, cover my/their skin with bark
description: +2 innate PAC; stacks with other AC but not with itself.

name: Ensnare
verbal: May the powers of Nature hold thee!
description: Animates nearby vegetation to entangle in a 3’×3’ area (typically legs). Non-magical; may be cut free at ref’s discretion.

name: Slow Poison
verbal: May the power of water slow this poison
description: Delays poisons in a flesh-and-blood (non-elvenkind) target until expiry; excess healing beyond tblp offsets delayed poison when it ends.

name: Camouflage
verbal: Branches and leaves hide me/him/her from my/his/her foes
description: While standing against natural vegetation, recipient is indiscernible to the naked eye; moving/casting reveals them.

name: Druidic Heal
verbal: Water heal and fire seal!
description: Heals a flesh-and-blood target (not elvenkind) for 12 tblp and 12 locational damage (split as desired).

name: Invisibility to Animals
verbal: Air shield me from the sight, smell and ear of all animals
description: Caster is undetectable to normal and giant animals (sight, smell, sound). Ends if caster attacks or uses other power.

name: Speak With Animals
verbal: Powers of Nature allow me to converse with animals
description: Caster converses with animals; does not grant extra intelligence or friendliness beyond understanding.

name: Speak With Plants
verbal: Plants, speak with me and relate what thou knowest
description: Caster converses with plants; normal plants are friendly but know little beyond their nature/interactions.

name: Cudgel
verbal: May Earthpower infuse this club
description: Touched wooden weapon becomes +1 (for the caster) and immune to destruction effects like Shatter.

name: Neutrality to Animals
verbal: Let the trust of the animals be upon me
description: Animals will not attack the caster. If the caster attacks any animal, the effect ends and is locked for 1 real-year.

name: Neutrality to Plants
verbal: Let the trust of the plants be upon me
description: Plants will not attack the caster. If the caster attacks any plant, the effect ends and is locked for 1 real-year.

name: Resist Fire
verbal: May water shield me/thee from scorching heat
description: Immunity to normal fire and half effect from supernatural fire for the duration; cumulative with published resistances.

name: Resist Cold
verbal: Let the warmth of the sun be upon me/thee
description: No effect from natural cold and half effect from supernatural cold for the duration.

name: Wall of Thorns
verbal: Powers of Earth grow for me a wall of thorns
description: Creates a 20’×10’ thorn wall. +1 Strength to push through (8 hits on success). Can be cut down with 200 sharp hits; fire does double.

name: Animate Small Tree
verbal: Earthpower infuse this tree as a treant to do as I direct
description: Animates a small tree as a treant (15 hits; 9-pt double unarmed; 4th-level resistances). Double damage from fire/axes; half from blunt; ¾ move.

name: Cure Disease
verbal: Purifying flame destroy this infection
description: Removes all diseases from one target/object; works on the disease (so can cure elves and supernatural diseases).

name: Animate Medium Tree
verbal: Greater Earthpower, infuse this tree with thy power as a treant to do as I direct
description: Animates a medium tree as a treant (25 hits; 12-pt double unarmed; 5th-level resistances). Fire/axes double; blunt half; ¾ move.

name: Gust of Wind
verbal: By the greater powers of air and sky—gust of wind
description: All in a 60° cone (20’ length) are blown back 10 paces (or 5 paces with +1 Str).

name: Neutralise Poison
verbal: Fire and water purify this poisoned [object/person].
description: Removes all poisons from one creature/object; on liquids up to 60 hits of poison or 1000 cubic feet (whichever less).

name: Forest Shift
verbal: Powers of the Forest take me away!
description: Shift between trees/forests in LoS, or to memorised ‘home tree’. Travel time equals walking time (max 15 minutes).

name: Animate Large Tree
verbal: All the greater powers of the earth come into this tree and animate it as a greater treant to do as I direct
description: Animates a large tree as a treant (50 hits; 15-pt triple unarmed; 6th-level resistances). Fire/axes double; blunt half; ¾ move.

name: Call Lightning
verbal: By the powers of air, wind and thunder...Call Lightning!
description: Must be under a reasonably cloudy sky (usually outdoors). One target takes 36/6 electrical damage (12 hits to monsters).

name: Joining
verbal: May your ties to the world be reaffirmed by this act of joining
description: An EP Mark Ally. Costs 1 tblp; only on willing targets not immune to beneficial Earthpower (elves are not immune). Counts as a 1 EP evocation to learn. Certain evocations can only be cast upon those under this effect, and the mark is specific to the Druid who applied it.

name: Bandage Infusion
verbal: May the strength of the world abide here for a time and may its strength replenish thine own
description: Tie a bandage; after 30s the target receives 4/4 curing (1 HTK). Bandage must remain for full duration; stacks with published bandaging where relevant.

name: Handfire
verbal: Fire come and light my way
description: Creates a small pillar of mystic fire as light; hovers near caster; requires concentration to move; fails if caster runs/fights/casts.

name: Hasten Venom
verbal: May poisons flow as raging rivers!
description: Speeds the onset/effects of venoms per full write-up.

name: Breeze
description: As per advanced listing; minor wind manipulation per write-up.

name: Druidic Harm
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Greater Water of Life
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Greater Water of Spite
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Owl’s Vision
verbal: May the world grant [me/thee] the bright eyes of the owl
description: See through all forms of supernatural darkness for the duration. Self or recipient of Joining only.

name: Hail Storm
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Greater Druidic Heal
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Greater Druidic Harm
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Greater Ensnare
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Endurance of the Mountains
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Envenom
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Grand Howl
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Greater Cudgel
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Meld With Earth
description: As per advanced listing.

name: Well of Knowledge
verbal: As I drink from the Well of Knowledge I abjure thee, open my eyes and let me see the truth of all things!
description: 3 questions as a Communication II miracle (up to 7 words each) about physical/natural matters; must ritually drink water before each.

name: Walk Through Earth
verbal: Powers of Earth embrace me and let me pass unhindered
description: Pass through non-supernatural earth/stone at will; brief disorientation emerging (cf. Walk Through Walls).

name: Travelling the World Tree
verbal: From here to there we wish to travel! May the pathways open! Each must pay a toll, which the World Tree seeks
description: Opens a portal between trees (LoS or memorised). Travel takes 15 minutes; each traveller takes 12 tblp; 12 EP to open + 1 EP per traveller.

name: Spring's Soothing Rain
verbal: Let the cleansing touch of spring’s rain be upon be and allow me to nurture the ills of the world for a time
description: Caster may cast Druidic Heal once per 5 minutes for 6 tblp; EP cannot be regained while active; only one at a time; cannot be enhanced.
